info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Driver Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of drivers associated with food delivery operations. This endpoint supports businesses in managing delivery logistics by providing up-to-date information on available drivers. Typical consumers include food delivery service providers and logistics coordinators looking to optimize their delivery processes. Utilize this API to enhance order fulfillment and improve overall customer satisfaction through efficient driver assignment.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information regarding deliveries assigned to a specific driver. It provides insights into current and past deliveries for efficient management.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve driver delivery information. This request body should contain the necessary parameters for identifying the driver and the specific delivery operations required.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning driver delivery information.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesDriversRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to driver deliveries. The request body is expected to be a string.
